# Third-party runtime notices

ASTRAEA-JP keeps the following browser runtime dependencies in this repository so released cards can pin every executable and media request to an immutable `eumenes12ds/ASTRAEA-JP` tag.

| Component | Version/source | License or provenance |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Scheduler | 0.27.0 | MIT |
| Immer | 11.1.18 | MIT |
| GSAP | 3.15.0 | [GSAP Standard “no charge” license](https://gsap.com/standard-license/) |
| JSON5 | 2.2.3 | MIT |
| OpenSeadragon | 6.1.0 | BSD-3-Clause |
| Pinia | 4.0.3 | MIT |
| Klona | 2.0.6 | MIT |
| compare-versions | 6.1.1 | MIT |
| jsonrepair | 3.15.0 | ISC |
| Zod | 4.5.4 | MIT |
| Tavern Resource `mvu_zod.js` | StageDog commit `4b3ce6130ebb039f6675583dce46a46d3f9cc4f1` | Upstream license copied to `licenses/StageDog-tavern_resource-LICENSE.txt` |
| Cinzel | Google Fonts v26 files | SIL Open Font License 1.1; text copied to `licenses/Cinzel-OFL.txt` |
| Noto Serif SC | Google Fonts v35 files | SIL Open Font License 1.1; text copied to `licenses/Noto-Serif-SC-OFL.txt` |
| Game Icons SVGs | Retrieved from Iconify’s `game-icons` collection | CC BY 3.0; icons by contributors listed at [game-icons.net](https://game-icons.net/) |
| `third-movement.mp3` | Existing ASTRAEA-JP card media formerly hosted as `files.catbox.moe/b0o5l9.mp3`; SHA-256 `236ce3dfd193d7eeb28748676f2060b4685e7db422efdf17ecbc22ea394322aa` | Existing project asset; original file did not carry embedded author/license metadata |

The generated jsDelivr ESM files retain their original package/version headers. This repository copy is the runtime delivery source; the upstream URLs are provenance only and are not loaded by released cards.
